items.text: 就像小时候，玛曼从旧衣服上拆下毛线，我们拿起线，在屋里绕着圈走，好让毛线不至于堆积起来。
现在也还好，可我总有个压厉，怕他下一刻就过来了。
items.q: Maman mangles the word for stress on purpose. Is that clear from '压厉'?

items.text: 《加油！吉塔斯》的片尾曲还没播完，亚瑟尔的“嘟嘟”声就从巷子里传来了。
items.q: Is '加油！吉塔斯' the known Chinese title of the cartoon Ganbare Kickers?

items.text: 他画了这个，下面写着：这不是一只烟斗。让人他妈的晕。
items.q: A girl jokes crudely about a painting. Does '他妈的晕' sound natural?

items.text: 也出去走走。去安净的地方。
items.q: Maman garbles the word for quiet on purpose: '安净'. Is that clear?

items.text: 以前有伤汗，比如说，还有结核病、麻疹。
items.q: Maman garbles the word for typhoid on purpose: '伤汗'. Is that clear?
Maman catches only the end of the series title Tears and Smiles. Is that clear?

items.text: – 哦哟，哈米德·猫，你昨天还说“哈尔”，今天突然文明了，改说“驴”了？
items.q: Taghi mocks Hamid for switching to a politer word for donkey. Does it work?

items.text: – “阿拉斯特”是“阿拉阿斯特”被皮拉斯特——修剪——之后的样子吗？
items.q: The guard jokes Arasteh is a trimmed Araasteh (Persian: neat). Does this make sense?

items.text: – 你呢，说话这副屌样，你的名字应该叫“阿拉特·德龙”。别自作多情，我说的不是阿兰·德龙，瞧你皱起鼻子......
items.q: '阿拉特·德龙' is meant as a rude pun on Alain Delon. Does it work?

items.text: – 是大米石。大米石就是很贵很贵的意思。
items.q: A child garbles marble as '大米石', thinking it means expensive. Is that clear?

items.text: ——可他还是说砸了。鹰眼说的是皮尔对皮尔，酒馆客听成了长老对长老。
items.q: Amir misheard peer as pir, Persian for elder. Does the joke work?

items.text: ——嗖——巴巴巴巴，你给我买介个大娃娃好不好？
items.q: A toddler asks her dad for a doll. Does it sound like baby talk?
This Hafez line should read both as real wine and as metaphor. Does it?

items.text: 他们用布尔多泽尔往她身上倒土。土和石灰。
items.q: Maman garbles bulldozer on purpose as '布尔多泽尔'. Is that clear?
